g.text: U2401 is the dedicated STM32G0B1 power sequencer for MIRA.

g.desc: U2401 is the dedicated STM32G0B1 power sequencer for MIRA.

g.text: It remains active on AON while the switched rails are disabled,

g.desc: It remains active on AON while the switched rails are disabled,

g.text: so it can coordinate startup, monitor supplies and handle faults.

g.desc: so it can coordinate startup, monitor supplies and handle faults.

g.text: The FPGA controls matrix timing; STM32H745 runs neuron models.

g.desc: The FPGA controls matrix timing; STM32H745 runs neuron models.

g.text: EN_REQ_* requests the individual converter enables.

g.desc: EN_REQ_* requests the individual converter enables.

g.text: PG_*, PGR_* and ALL_RAILS_PG report supply readiness.

g.desc: PG_*, PGR_* and ALL_RAILS_PG report supply readiness.

g.text: PA0 / PA1 / PA2 / PA3 measure current, voltage, VTT and PROG_P15.

g.desc: PA0 / PA1 / PA2 / PA3 measure current, voltage, VTT and PROG_P15.

g.text: MUX_A0..A3 select telemetry channels; MUX_DISABLE gates the mux.

g.desc: MUX_A0..A3 select telemetry channels; MUX_DISABLE gates the mux.

g.text: Wait for PC14 CLEAR before PWR_ARM; PC15 LINK_READY before MATRIX_ARM.

g.desc: Wait for PC14 CLEAR before PWR_ARM; PC15 LINK_READY before MATRIX_ARM.

g.text: Service PM_WDI throughout startup and shutdown.

g.desc: Service PM_WDI throughout startup and shutdown.

g.text: Use internal clocking; PF0, PC14 and PC15 are GPIO, not HSE/LSE.

g.desc: Use internal clocking; PF0, PC14 and PC15 are GPIO, not HSE/LSE.

g.text: PWR_ARM_PULSE and MATRIX_ARM_PULSE clock the permit latches.

g.desc: PWR_ARM_PULSE and MATRIX_ARM_PULSE clock the permit latches.

g.text: GLOBAL_PWR_PERMIT and MATRIX_PERMIT are status inputs.

g.desc: GLOBAL_PWR_PERMIT and MATRIX_PERMIT are status inputs.

g.text: PWR_KILL_GPIO and MATRIX_KILL_GPIO request hardware shutdown.

g.desc: PWR_KILL_GPIO and MATRIX_KILL_GPIO request hardware shutdown.

g.text: PM_UART_TX / RX use USART3 on PD8 / PD9, alternate function 0.

g.desc: PM_UART_TX / RX use USART3 on PD8 / PD9, alternate function 0.

g.text: PM_RESET_N combines AON reset and the PM watchdog fault.

g.desc: PM_RESET_N combines AON reset and the PM watchdog fault.

g.text: Hardware permits qualify enable requests independently of code.

g.desc: Hardware permits qualify enable requests independently of code.

g.text: Firmware must initialize requests safely, verify ready signals,

g.desc: Firmware must initialize requests safely, verify ready signals,

g.text: and arm the matrix only after supplies and host status are valid.

g.desc: and arm the matrix only after supplies and host status are valid.

g.text: Requests startup; hardware latches retain the permits.

g.desc: Requests startup; hardware latches retain the permits.

g.text: Matrix timing and neural computation are handled elsewhere.

g.desc: Matrix timing and neural computation are handled elsewhere.

g.text: AON is also the ADC reference.

g.desc: AON is also the ADC reference.

g.text: Keep the internal VREFBUF output disabled.

g.desc: Keep the internal VREFBUF output disabled.

g.text: PC14: GLOBAL_CLEAR_N; PC15: LINK_READY_H. Inputs, no pull; LSE OFF.

g.desc: PC14: GLOBAL_CLEAR_N; PC15: LINK_READY_H. Inputs, no pull; LSE OFF.

g.text: Wait for CLEAR before PWR_ARM; LINK_READY before MATRIX_ARM.

g.desc: Wait for CLEAR before PWR_ARM; LINK_READY before MATRIX_ARM.

g.text: Read HOST_ALIVE_PM as a heartbeat; verify both permit outputs.

g.desc: Read HOST_ALIVE_PM as a heartbeat; verify both permit outputs.
